say:0:1028301001:0.text: Those two were muttering at a stone tablet, things like "ancient" and "major discovery". ...Hmm, seems a bit suspicious.
say:0:1028301001:0.source_cn: 那两个人对着块石头嘀嘀咕咕，什么“上古”“大发现”……...

say:1:1028301002:0.text: Human outsiders... The area has already been sealed off. Who are they, and how did they get in?
say:1:1028301002:0.source_cn: 是外面的人类……周围已经封锁了，他们是谁，怎么进来的？

say:2:1028301003:0.source_cn: 这俩人……感觉有点眼熟啊。

say:1:1028303001:0.text: Renowned Magister, you're just in time. Please join me in witnessing an integral moment in my archaeological career.
say:1:1028303001:0.male: Renowned Magister, you're just in time. Please join me in witnessing an integral moment in my archaeological career.
say:1:1028303001:0.female: Renowned Magister, you're just in time. Please join me in witnessing an integral moment in my archaeological career.

say:2:1028303002:0.text: Wait, Gali, I'm not saying your translation is wrong, but we have to be careful in regard to the content on this tablet.
say:2:1028303002:0.source_cn: 等等，伽利，我不是说你的翻译有错，但我们必须要谨慎对待...

say:3:1028303003:0.text: What are you saying? Although it may seem like a small speck of dust blown from the layers of history, we're dealing with a phenomenal discovery.
say:3:1028303003:0.source_cn: 说什么呢，梅丽莎，虽然只是吹开了历史尘埃中的一点浮土，...

say:4:1028303004:0.text: An elixir from an ancient time that grants eternal youth! Just think about what this means for the field of archaeology!
say:4:1028303004:0.source_cn: 来自上古、能让人“永葆青春”的灵药！想想看，这对考古学...

say:5:1028303005:0.text: But we need more historical documents and artifacts to verify it...
say:5:1028303005:0.source_cn: 但我们需要更多的历史文献或文物来佐证……

say:6:1028303006:0.text: Sorry to interrupt. Did you say eternal youth?
say:6:1028303006:0.source_cn: 抱歉，打断一下二位——你们说“永葆青春”？

say:7:1028303007:0.text: Yes... Gali translated the tablet, and it mentions such an elixir.
say:7:1028303007:0.source_cn: 是的……伽利翻译出来，说这块石碑上面记载了一种能让人“...

say:8:1028303008:0.text: What an exciting discovery! Enough to be the greatest find in the archaeological world this year!
say:8:1028303008:0.source_cn: 多么令人兴奋的事实！足以成为本年度考古界最伟大的发现！

say:10:1028303009:0.text: But I've never heard of anything like that existing in the Dark Forest. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, have you?
say:10:1028303009:0.source_cn: 但我从未听说过……也没有在薄暮丛林中听到任何人提过类似...
say:10:1028303009:0.male: But I've never heard of anything like that existing in the Dark Forest. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, have you?
say:10:1028303009:0.female: But I've never heard of anything like that existing in the Dark Forest. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, have you?

choice_prompt:11:1028303009.text: But I've never heard of anything like that existing in the Dark Forest. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, have you?
choice_prompt:11:1028303009.source_cn: 但我从未听说过……也没有在薄暮丛林中听到任何人提过类似的事情。<style=stress><player_name></style>，你呢？
choice_prompt:11:1028303009.male: But I've never heard of anything like that existing in the Dark Forest. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, have you?
choice_prompt:11:1028303009.female: But I've never heard of anything like that existing in the Dark Forest. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, have you?

say:12:1028303010:0.text: Moreover, this record might not be credible. "Eternal youth?" Clearly, there are many elderly folks among the Wilders.
say:12:1028303010:0.source_cn: 而且……这记载或许并不可信。永葆青春？绿裔里明明有不少...

say:13:1028303011:0.text: All the more reason to ask around nearby! There's bound to be someone who knows something!
say:13:1028303011:0.source_cn: 所以我们更应该找附近的居民打听一下，总会有人知道些什么吧！

choice_prompt:14:1028303011.text: All the more reason to ask around nearby! There's bound to be someone who knows something!
choice_prompt:14:1028303011.source_cn: 所以我们更应该找附近的居民打听一下，总会有人知道些什么吧！

say:15:1028303012:0.text: Welcome aboard, Magister! It's time to become a participant and witness to this major archaeological discovery!
say:15:1028303012:0.source_cn: 啊，欢迎加入！欢迎我们的魔法师<male>先生</ma...
say:15:1028303012:0.male: Welcome aboard, Magister! It's time to become a participant and witness to this major archaeological discovery!
say:15:1028303012:0.female: Welcome aboard, Magister! It's time to become a participant and witness to this major archaeological discovery!

say:16:1028303013:0.text: Okay, since you all agree... is there a settlement nearby where I can gather information?
say:16:1028303013:0.source_cn: 好吧，既然你们都同意……附近有什么聚落可以打听消息吗？

say:18:1028303014:0.source_cn: 月影乡倒是在这附近，但……

say:19:1028303015:0.text: The legendary Ivoryshade? That's great! Let's get moving!
say:19:1028303015:0.source_cn: 那个传说中的月影乡？太棒了！我们这就去！

say:0:1028304001:0.text: I never thought I'd be able to visit Ivoryshade! Haha, this stone tablet surely is a lucky one!
say:0:1028304001:0.source_cn: 没想到可以去一次月影乡，哈哈，这块石碑果真是我的幸运之碑啊！

say:1:1028304002:0.text: So Ivoryshade is nearby... Looks like our map is indeed not comprehensive enough.
say:1:1028304002:0.source_cn: 原来月影乡就在这附近……嗯，我们地图果然还不够完善。

say:1:1028305001:1.text: Dura above! I've wanted to see it for the longest time!
say:1:1028305001:1.source_cn: 月影乡，艾雅在上，我早就想来这里看看了！

say:2:1028305002:1.text: Please wait... at the moment, I'm afraid it may not be suitable for you to enter.
say:2:1028305002:1.source_cn: 不，请等等……最近这段时间，恐怕你们并不适合进入这里。

say:3:1028305003:1.text: I'm sorry; recently, members of the Adamant Syndicate went on a rampage, causing enormous trouble here.
say:3:1028305003:1.source_cn: 抱歉，这并非我们排斥外人，而是不久前，黑金商会的人在这...

say:4:1028305004:1.text: I see... and that's why you've sealed everything off?
say:4:1028305004:1.source_cn: 原来如此……所以你们才封锁了这片地区？

say:5:1028305005:1.text: Yes, the residents of Ivoryshade are wary of outsiders right now.
say:5:1028305005:1.source_cn: 是的。月影乡居民现在对外来者很是戒备，他们担心重蹈覆辙...

say:6:1028305006:1.text: You're kidding! Ever since I read the novel "Lost Village" years ago, I've been eagerly awaiting the chance to come here and explore...
say:6:1028305006:1.source_cn: 不是吧！我从十年前读过《失落之乡》那本探险小说以后，就...
say:6:1028305006:1.male: You're kidding! Ever since I read the novel "Lost Village" years ago, I've been eagerly awaiting the chance to come here and explore...
say:6:1028305006:1.female: You're kidding! Ever since I read the novel "Lost Village" years ago, I've been eagerly awaiting the chance to come here and explore...

choice_prompt:7:1028305006.text: You're kidding! Ever since I read the novel "Lost Village" years ago, I've been eagerly awaiting the chance to come here and explore...
choice_prompt:7:1028305006.source_cn: 不是吧！我从十年前读过《失落之乡》那本探险小说以后，就无比盼望能够来这里一探究竟……
choice_prompt:7:1028305006.male: You're kidding! Ever since I read the novel "Lost Village" years ago, I've been eagerly awaiting the chance to come here and explore...
choice_prompt:7:1028305006.female: You're kidding! Ever since I read the novel "Lost Village" years ago, I've been eagerly awaiting the chance to come here and explore...

say:9:1028305007:1.text: That's right. When everything's back to normal, you'll be welcomed with open arms.
say:9:1028305007:1.source_cn: 就是嘛，等一切恢复正常，大家肯定很愿意好好招待你。

say:10:1028305008:1.text: But alas, there's no telling when that will be... what a pity.
say:10:1028305008:1.source_cn: 唉，还不知道下次再来是什么时候……太可惜了。

say:11:1028305011:1.text: Well, I'm counting on you to help investigate the situation.
say:11:1028305011:1.source_cn: 那么，就拜托你们帮忙打探情况了。

say:12:1028305012:1.text: Wait, our magister friend isn't a Wilder, either! For what reason is he allowed in Ivoryshade?
say:12:1028305012:1.source_cn: 等等……我们的魔法师朋友也不是绿裔啊！为什么<male...
say:12:1028305012:1.male: Wait, our magister friend isn't a Wilder, either! For what reason is he allowed in Ivoryshade?
say:12:1028305012:1.female: Wait, our magister friend isn't a Wilder, either! For what reason is she allowed in Ivoryshade?

say:13:1028305013:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style> is the one I invited to help with the forest corruption and someone I can trust.
say:13:1028305013:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style> is the one I invited to help with the forest corruption and someone I can trust.
say:13:1028305013:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style> is the one I invited to help with the forest corruption and someone I can trust.

say:14:1028305014:1.text: Alright, alright... then I'll just have to gaze at this legendary place from a distance and await news as its sight haunts me teasingly.
say:14:1028305014:1.source_cn: 好吧，好吧……那我就只好远远眺望一下这让我魂牵梦萦的传...

say:17:1028305009:1.text: Residents have been on edge lately, and the Thorned Guards won't take any infractions lightly.
say:17:1028305009:1.source_cn: 附近居民最近都很敏感，要是引起大家的误会，荆棘卫队可不...

say:18:1028305010:1.text: With Gali's luck, he might really be mistaken as a troublemaker.
say:18:1028305010:1.source_cn: 以伽利的运气，说不定还真会被他们当成搞破坏的……

choice:7:1:2.text: They don't know if they can trust you.
choice:7:1:2.male: They don't know if they can trust you.
choice:7:1:2.female: They don't know if they can trust you.

say:0:1028306001:0.text: We're depending on you. We'll be here waiting for your return.
say:0:1028306001:0.source_cn: 拜托你们了，我们在这里等你们回来。

say:0:1028308001:0.text: The old woman sipping tea over there looks friendly. Maybe we can ask her some questions.
say:0:1028308001:0.source_cn: 那边品茶的老人家，看起来面相很和善，或许能找他问问情况。

say:1:1028308002:0.text: Good idea! Old folks are always full of stories and juicy secrets!
say:1:1028308002:0.source_cn: 好主意，老人总是知道很多有趣的秘密！

say:3:1028309001:1.text: Ah, you there. You know, it's best not to roam around too much lately; people are quite on edge...
say:3:1028309001:1.source_cn: 是你们啊。唉，最近还是别到处乱跑，大伙都人心惶惶的……

say:4:1028309002:1.text: Greetings, honorable elder; we just wanted to ask some questions related to medicinal plants.
say:4:1028309002:1.source_cn: 您好，尊敬的长者，我们只是想来问一些和药用植物有关的问题。

say:5:1028309003:1.text: Medicinal plants? You've come to the right man. The leaves for this scented tea, an exclusive recipe, were personally grown and picked by me.
say:5:1028309003:1.source_cn: 药用植物？这你们可问对人了。这些花茶都是我亲自采摘配制...

say:7:1028309004:0.text: Would you care to try some?

say:8:1028309005:1.source_cn: 好啊好啊！让我试试……\n哇哦！哇哦哇哦哇哦！

choice_prompt:9:1028309005.source_cn: 好啊好啊！让我试试……\n哇哦！哇哦哇哦哇哦！

say:10:1028309006:1.text: It's so... fragrant! With just a sip, it feels like I could fly. I feel like a kid again!
say:10:1028309006:1.source_cn: 真——香啊！这么一杯下去，感觉我的灵魂都要飞上天，像是...

say:11:1028309007:1.text: Wow, this tea doesn't really have the power to reverse aging, does it?! It's incredible!
say:11:1028309007:1.source_cn: 天啊，老人家，你这茶不会能让人返老还童吧？！太神奇了！

say:12:1028309008:1.text: Haha, I thank you for the compliment. But if it could, how would that explain all my wrinkles?
say:12:1028309008:1.source_cn: 哈哈，多谢你的称赞，要真能像你说的那样，我怎么还会是现...

say:13:1028309009:1.text: Now, what about medicinal plants did you want to ask me about?
say:13:1028309009:1.source_cn: 好啦，年轻人，你们要找我问的“药用植物”是什么？

choice_prompt:14:1028309009.text: Now, what about medicinal plants did you want to ask me about?
choice_prompt:14:1028309009.source_cn: 好啦，年轻人，你们要找我问的“药用植物”是什么？

say:15:1028309010:1.text: Ah, most of these plants can be found nearby, and are most potent within a day of being harvested.
say:15:1028309010:1.source_cn: 哦，这几种植物大部分都在附近能找到，采摘后一日内，效果最佳。

say:16:1028309011:1.text: Magic sprouts can only be collected from mana sprites. Those little buggers can sure run fast...
say:16:1028309011:1.source_cn: 啊对了，你们要记住，新鲜的魔力嫩芽只能在魔花种子上采集...

say:17:1028309012:1.text: Also, the plants you're asking about are herbs with complex medicinal properties. You can't just consume them carelessly!
say:17:1028309012:1.source_cn: 还有还有，你们问的那些植物都是药草，药性复杂，可不敢随...

say:18:1028309013:1.text: If someone is sick, make sure they see a healer or physician for a proper prescription first...
say:18:1028309013:1.source_cn: 要是有人生病的话，记得要先去找医师开药方……

choice:14:0:1.text: Where can we find those plants?
choice:14:0:1.male: Where can we find those plants?
choice:14:0:1.female: Where can we find those plants?

say:0:1028310001:0.text: The other herbs are easy to come by, but magic sprouts... those will be hard to find.
say:0:1028310001:0.source_cn: 其他的药草都好说，但新鲜的魔力嫩芽……这可不好找。
say:0:1028310001:0.male: The other herbs are easy to come by, but magic sprouts... those will be hard to find.
say:0:1028310001:0.female: The other herbs are easy to come by, but magic sprouts... those will be hard to find.

say:1:1028310002:0.text: Let's head back. Melissa and Gali are probably getting anxious.
say:1:1028310002:0.source_cn: 我们先回去一趟，梅丽莎和伽利恐怕已经等急了。
say:1:1028310002:0.male: Let's head back. Melissa and Gali are probably getting anxious.
say:1:1028310002:0.female: Let's head back. Melissa and Gali are probably getting anxious.

say:3:1028311001:1.text: "Magic sprouts" can only be gathered from mana sprites... well, I've seen manafleurs before, but I've never seen a mana sprite.
say:3:1028311001:1.source_cn: “新鲜的魔力嫩芽”只能在魔花种子上采集到……呃，魔花我...

say:4:1028311002:1.text: They aren't mentioned in the Wilderness Biology Atlas, either.
say:4:1028311002:1.source_cn: 《野外生物图鉴》里也没提到过啊……

say:5:1028311003:1.text: Have you ever seen them? Those bouncy, shy little guys in the forest who, at the slightest breeze, "swoosh—" and run away!
say:5:1028311003:1.source_cn: 你们或许见过？丛林里那些蹦蹦跳跳的害羞小家伙，只要有一...

say:6:1028311004:1.text: With how sensitive those little critters are, it'd be impossible to just walk up and pluck off those magic sprouts.
say:6:1028311004:1.source_cn: 以那些小家伙的灵敏，谁也别想直接从它们身上采摘魔力嫩芽。

say:7:1028311005:1.text: Easily scared, extremely evasive, protective of their sprouts... We'll have to think outside the box.
say:7:1028311005:1.source_cn: 害羞、容易逃跑、无法采摘，得想个办法……

say:8:1028311006:1.text: Maybe we could ask them if they're willing to make a deal with us?
say:8:1028311006:1.source_cn: 也许可以试着问问它们，愿不愿意跟我们做个交易？

say:9:1028311007:1.text: A deal? Unless Misarte herself intervenes, they'll never understand our words or even body language.
say:9:1028311007:1.source_cn: 交易？除非弥萨忒显灵，否则它们绝对无法理解我们的语言，...

say:10:1028311008:1.text: It's a shame. I'm very good at communicating with other creatures like gruglins, and I've even dealt with golems before...
say:10:1028311008:1.source_cn: 真可惜，我可是很擅长和其他的生物交流沟通的，比如咕布林...

say:11:1028311009:2.text: Huh, speaking of gruglins... I just had an idea! We could capture a mana sprite!
say:11:1028311009:2.source_cn: 咦，说起咕布林……我想到了！我们可以捕捉一只魔花种子！

say:14:1028311011:1.text: That's right, with a trap! It's a simple, effective solution.
say:14:1028311011:1.source_cn: 没错，用陷阱！简单又有效的方案，正适合现在这种情况。

say:15:1028311012:1.text: I've already got a place in mind, it couldn't be more perfect.
say:15:1028311012:1.source_cn: 我已经想到了布置陷阱的地方，再没有比那里更合适的了。

say:16:1028311013:1.source_cn: 事不宜迟，咱们分头行动！

say:0:1028312001:0.text: Whew... He runs so fast... are all you archaeologists like this, or is it just him?
say:0:1028312001:0.source_cn: 他跑得可真够快的……你们考古学家都是这样，还是只有他这样？

say:2:1028312003:0.text: Let's see what he's up to.
say:2:1028312003:0.male: Let's see what he's up to.
say:2:1028312003:0.female: Let's see what he's up to.

say:2:1028313001:2.text: Gotta make sure I don't leave any footprints. Cover it up with some loose soil and leaves... perfect!
say:2:1028313001:2.source_cn: 哎，别踩那里！不要留下脚印！盖上浮土，铺上草皮和落叶…...

say:3:1028313002:1.text: The trap should blend in with our surroundings quite naturally so that our prey relaxes with a false sense of security and becomes careless...
say:3:1028313002:1.source_cn: 陷阱要和周围的环境融合，逼真且自然，让猎物因安全感而放...

say:5:1028313003:1.text: What are you looking at? I learned a lot from the trap with the gruglin, and even made some new breakthroughs!
say:5:1028313003:1.source_cn: 怎么样？我可是在那个困住咕布林的陷阱上学到了很多新东西...

say:6:1028313004:1.text: A true scholar is one who never fails to learn something, even when he's in trouble.
say:6:1028313004:1.source_cn: 身陷困境也不忘及汲取知识，这才是真正的学者。

say:7:1028313005:1.text: May I ask you, sir "true scholar", how this trap is going to play out?
say:7:1028313005:1.source_cn: 请问真正的学者先生，这个陷阱要怎么发挥它的作用？

say:8:1028313006:1.text: Easy! You drive the little critters in this direction, one steps on the trap in a panic, and plop goes the sprite.
say:8:1028313006:1.source_cn: 很简单，你们把魔花种子赶到这里，让它们慌不择路，“噗通...

say:10:1028313008:1.text: Yup! Exceptional traps often only require the most rudimentary construction. I assure you, it will live up to expectations.
say:10:1028313008:1.source_cn: 那当然！出色的陷阱往往只需要简单的触发方式，我向你们保...

say:0:1028314001:0.text: I'll stay here to make sure the trap remains intact, while you go flush out a mana sprite!
say:0:1028314001:0.source_cn: 我留在这里确保陷阱完好，寻找魔花种子的事情就拜托你们啦！

say:0:1028315001:0.text: Those were mana sprites! Wow, they run so fast...
say:0:1028315001:0.source_cn: 是魔花种子！它们跑得可真快啊……

say:1:1028315002:0.text: They ran toward the trap. Let's keep up the chase.
say:1:1028315002:0.source_cn: 它们往陷阱方向跑了……我们继续追。
say:1:1028315002:0.male: They ran toward the trap. Let's keep up the chase.
say:1:1028315002:0.female: They ran toward the trap. Let's keep up the chase.

say:0:1028316001:0.text: There are some strange, faint sounds up ahead... sounds like monsters.
say:0:1028316001:0.source_cn: 前面有些微弱的声音……可能有怪物。

say:1:1028316002:0.text: Let's find out; we need to make sure they don't harm the mana sprites.
say:1:1028316002:0.source_cn: 我们去看看，得保证怪物不会伤害到魔花种子。
say:1:1028316002:0.male: Let's find out; we need to make sure they don't harm the mana sprites.
say:1:1028316002:0.female: Let's find out; we need to make sure they don't harm the mana sprites.

say:0:1028317001:0.text: Not this way, little ones... that's it, go that way!
say:0:1028317001:0.source_cn: 不是这条路，小家伙们……对，这就对了，往那边跑！

say:1:1028318001:1.text: Haha, it worked! I told you the trap was sound.
say:1:1028318001:1.source_cn: 哈哈，成功了！我就说我的陷阱一定没问题的！

say:2:1028318002:1.text: The magic sprouts should be on top of its head...
say:2:1028318002:1.source_cn: 它头上的应该就是魔力嫩芽吧……

say:3:1028318003:1.text: Come on, pick some off while you can!
say:3:1028318003:1.source_cn: 快，就趁现在，赶紧把它采下来！

say:2:1028318101:1.text: Great job! Next... Melissa? What's the matter?
say:2:1028318101:1.source_cn: 大功告成！接下来……梅丽莎？你怎么在走神？

say:3:1028318102:1.text: Can we release the mana sprite? We only needed it for its sprouts, after all.
say:3:1028318102:1.source_cn: 可以把这只魔花种子放了吗？我们只是为了采魔力嫩芽……

choice_prompt:4:1028318102.text: Can we release the mana sprite? We only needed it for its sprouts, after all.
choice_prompt:4:1028318102.source_cn: 可以把这只魔花种子放了吗？我们只是为了采魔力嫩芽……

say:5:1028318103:1.text: Well, we got what we came for, so... come now, little fella, I'll help you out... ouch!!!
say:5:1028318103:1.source_cn: 好吧，反正已经采到需要的东西了……我来搭把手，出来吧小...

say:6:1028318104:1.text: It... it poked me with its thorn! Ouch! It hurts!
say:6:1028318104:1.source_cn: 它……它用叶子戳我！好疼！疼疼疼！

say:7:1028318105:1.text: It turns out the thorns of mana sprites can cause allergic reactions in some, which is new knowledge! Write that down, Melissa!
say:7:1028318105:1.source_cn: 原来魔花种子的刺还能导致人过敏，又是新知识！快记下来，...

choice_prompt:8:1028318105.text: It turns out the thorns of mana sprites can cause allergic reactions in some, which is new knowledge! Write that down, Melissa!
choice_prompt:8:1028318105.source_cn: 原来魔花种子的刺还能导致人过敏，又是新知识！快记下来，梅丽莎！

say:9:1028318106:1.text:
Ugh, I wanted to see it get out the rest of its frustration...
Oh well, run along quickly, little sprite.
say:9:1028318106:1.source_cn: 唉，真想让它彻底发泄个够……\n算了，快点逃走吧，魔花种子。

say:3:1028320001:1.text: Gold-rimmed moonwart, blue blossom, autumnal narcissus powder, and of course, magic sprouts! It's all here. Let's get to work!
say:3:1028320001:1.source_cn: 金边月亮草、蓝楹花、秋水仙粉末、新鲜魔力嫩芽……东西都...

say:4:1028320002:1.text: I guess I'm too excited; my hands are shaking a bit... Magister, can you assist with concocting the elixir?
say:4:1028320002:1.source_cn: 大概是太激动了，我的手有点发抖……魔法师<male>先...
say:4:1028320002:1.male: I guess I'm too excited; my hands are shaking a bit... Magister, can you assist with concocting the elixir?
say:4:1028320002:1.female: I guess I'm too excited; my hands are shaking a bit... Magister, can you assist with concocting the elixir?

say:5:1028320003:1.text: Careful now... just bring plain water to a boil, add the ingredients in order with magic sprouts going last, and let it all soak until the mixture is golden in color.
say:5:1028320003:1.source_cn: 哎……小心点，先把纯水煮沸，依次放材料，最后放魔力嫩芽...
say:5:1028320003:1.male: Careful now... just bring plain water to a boil, add the ingredients in order with magic sprouts going last, and let it all soak until the mixture is golden in color.
say:5:1028320003:1.female: Careful now... just bring plain water to a boil, add the ingredients in order with magic sprouts going last, and let it all soak until the mixture is golden in color.

choice_prompt:6:1028320003.text: Careful now... just bring plain water to a boil, add the ingredients in order with magic sprouts going last, and let it all soak until the mixture is golden in color.
choice_prompt:6:1028320003.source_cn: 哎……小心点，先把纯水煮沸，依次放材料，最后放魔力嫩芽，浸泡至颜色金黄即可。
choice_prompt:6:1028320003.male: Careful now... just bring plain water to a boil, add the ingredients in order with magic sprouts going last, and let it all soak until the mixture is golden in color.
choice_prompt:6:1028320003.female: Careful now... just bring plain water to a boil, add the ingredients in order with magic sprouts going last, and let it all soak until the mixture is golden in color.

say:7:1028320004:1.text: Ah, it appears to have worked!

say:8:1028320005:1.text: Could this really be an elixir for everlasting youth? The color is lovely, and it has a pleasant scent...
say:8:1028320005:1.source_cn: 这就是能永葆青春的灵药？颜色很漂亮，闻起来也很舒服……

say:9:1028320006:1.text: There's a strange fragrance... hmm, this scent seems familiar...
say:9:1028320006:1.source_cn: 有股奇异的香气……嗯，这味道，似乎还有点熟悉……

say:10:1028320007:1.text: Gali, considering the age of this as-of-yet unverified ancient recipe, I'm not sure how I'd feel about hastily consuming it.
say:10:1028320007:1.source_cn: 伽利，这么古老的配方，还没有经过验证，恐怕还是不要贸然...

say:11:1028320008:1.text: You're right! That's why I'm going to verify it myself! Trial and error are the foundations of humanity!
say:11:1028320008:1.source_cn: 说的没错！所以我要亲自尝试！实践！学科的发展和人类的进...

say:12:1028320009:1.text: *Gulp, gulp*... It tastes a bit like herbal tea... start taking notes!
say:12:1028320009:1.source_cn: 咕嘟，咕嘟……喝起来有点像花草茶……开始记录！

say:13:1028320010:1.text: The initial flavor is nice, with the gold-rimmed moon wart coming through. After three seconds, a bitter taste develops at the base of the tongue...
say:13:1028320010:1.source_cn: 味道不错，先是金边月亮草的芳香味，舌根在3秒后开始……...

say:14:1028320011:1.text: Eight seconds... well... I'm... a little... dizzy...

say:17:1028320013:1.text: This isn't good. Check on him, quick!
say:17:1028320013:1.source_cn: 不好……快看看他怎么样了！

say:0:1028321001:0.text: How is he? Is he alright?
say:0:1028321001:0.male: How is he? Is he alright?
say:0:1028321001:0.female: How is he? Is he alright?

say:1:1028321002:0.text: Everything seems normal; it's just... he appears to be asleep...
say:1:1028321002:0.source_cn: 其他一切正常，他看起来好像……只是睡着了……
say:1:1028321002:0.male: Everything seems normal; it's just... he appears to be asleep...
say:1:1028321002:0.female: Everything seems normal; it's just... he appears to be asleep...

say:1:1028322001:1.text: We've tried everything, but can't seem to wake him up. What are we going to do?
say:1:1028322001:1.source_cn: 我们试了这么多种方法都叫不醒伽利，现在要怎么办？

say:2:1028322002:1.text: He can't keep sleeping like this...
say:2:1028322002:1.source_cn: 总不能让他一直这么睡下去……

say:3:1028322003:1.text: Perhaps I can find some help. I'm not sure where Master Arden is at the moment, but... Oh, I just remembered the kind old man in Ivoryshade!
say:3:1028322003:1.source_cn: 或许可以找人问问，不知道雅顿老爷子现在在哪里……等等，...

say:4:1028322004:1.text: He was very good at gathering herbs and mixing teas and made a point of telling us about the complex properties of these plants...
say:4:1028322004:1.source_cn: 他很擅长采集草药和配置花茶，还特地跟我们说这些植物的药...

say:5:1028322005:1.text: With Misarte's blessing, hopefully, he'll know how to deal with this.
say:5:1028322005:1.source_cn: 弥萨忒保佑，没准他知道些什么？

say:6:1028322006:1.text: Ivoryshade? I want to visit this old man in person!
say:6:1028322006:1.source_cn: 月影乡？拜托你们，我……我想亲自去拜访这位老人，求求你们了！

say:7:1028322007:1.text: Look... I know you mean no harm, but the people of Ivoryshade are still mistrusting of outsiders.
say:7:1028322007:1.source_cn: 这……我们知道你并不是坏人，但月影乡的人恐怕不会相信外人。

say:8:1028322008:1.text: Perhaps... <style="stress"><player_name></style> could help? With your powers, maybe you could alter her appearance.
say:8:1028322008:1.male: Perhaps... <style="stress"><player_name></style> could help? With your powers, maybe you could alter her appearance.
say:8:1028322008:1.female: Perhaps... <style="stress"><player_name></style> could help? With your powers, maybe you could alter her appearance.

choice_prompt:9:1028322008.text: Perhaps... <style="stress"><player_name></style> could help? With your powers, maybe you could alter her appearance.
choice_prompt:9:1028322008.source_cn: 或许……<style=stress><player_name></style>可以帮帮忙？以你的能力，应该可以改变她的样貌。
choice_prompt:9:1028322008.male: Perhaps... <style="stress"><player_name></style> could help? With your powers, maybe you could alter her appearance.
choice_prompt:9:1028322008.female: Perhaps... <style="stress"><player_name></style> could help? With your powers, maybe you could alter her appearance.

say:10:1028322009:1.text: That's right. If you disguise Melissa as a member of the Wilders, she should be able to enter Ivoryshade.
say:10:1028322009:1.source_cn: 没错，将梅丽莎易容成为一名绿裔成员，应该就可以带她进月...
say:10:1028322009:1.male: That's right. If you disguise Melissa as a member of the Wilders, she should be able to enter Ivoryshade.
say:10:1028322009:1.female: That's right. If you disguise Melissa as a member of the Wilders, she should be able to enter Ivoryshade.

say:11:1028322010:1.text: Could you really do this? Please, please!
say:11:1028322010:1.source_cn: 真的可以吗？拜托你们了！

choice_prompt:12:1028322010.text: Could you really do this? Please, please!
choice_prompt:12:1028322010.source_cn: 真的可以吗？拜托你们了！

say:16:1028322011:0.text: Did it... work? Is that me? This is amazing, I really grew animal ears! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, thanks a lot!
say:16:1028322011:0.source_cn: 这……这是我吗？太神奇了，真的能长出动物的耳朵……！<...
say:16:1028322011:0.male: Did it... work? Is that me? This is amazing, I really grew animal ears! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, thanks a lot!
say:16:1028322011:0.female: Did it... work? Is that me? This is amazing, I really grew animal ears! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, thanks a lot!

say:17:1028322012:1.text: Ha, I'm afraid if Gali saw me, he'd probably freak out. Let's get going... it's actually a bit odd without him constantly babbling our ears off.
say:17:1028322012:1.source_cn: 唉，要是伽利看到，恐怕又要大呼小叫了。我们还是快些出发...

say:18:1028322013:0.text: Let's get Gali back to the camp. Well... the camp should be safe enough for him.
say:18:1028322013:0.source_cn: 先把伽利送回营地。嗯……在营地总该是安全的吧……

narration:19:1028322014:0.text: After everyone helps Gali settle down...

say:0:1028323001:0.text: Mr. Gali, please take a rest here.
say:0:1028323001:0.source_cn: 伽利先生，你就先在营地舒服地睡一会吧。

say:1:1028323002:0.text: Thank you, Magister; now let's set out for Ivoryshade!
say:1:1028323002:0.male: Thank you, Magister; now let's set out for Ivoryshade!
say:1:1028323002:0.female: Thank you, Magister; now let's set out for Ivoryshade!

say:3:1028324001:1.text:
This elixir...
Tell me... did someone fall asleep after drinking it?
say:3:1028324001:1.source_cn: 这个药方是……\n你们几个……是不是有人喝了它之后沉睡...

say:4:1028324002:1.text: Yes. Might you know anything about it?
say:4:1028324002:1.source_cn: 是的。您……您知道这种灵药？

say:5:1028324003:1.text: Ugh... when you asked before about medicinal plants, I said not to consume them carelessly.
say:5:1028324003:1.source_cn: 唉，之前你们问过一些草药的生长位置，那会儿我就说了不要乱喝。

say:6:1028324004:0.text: The combination of those herbs can render a person unconscious. Only special smelling salts can awaken the consumer.
say:6:1028324004:0.source_cn: 这些草药组合起来能让人失去意识，彻底沉眠，只有一种特殊...

say:7:1028324005:1.text: Can you make these smelling salts?

say:8:1028324006:1.text: Of course. However, one of the main ingredients is golden honey.
say:8:1028324006:1.source_cn: 当然可以。不过，制作嗅盐的其中一种主材料叫“黄金蜂蜜”……

say:9:1028324007:1.text: It's quite rare and regarded as treasure by hornleaf bears. I'm afraid there's no way that I, with these creaky old bones, could retrieve any.
say:9:1028324007:1.source_cn: 那东西很少见，叶角熊把它当宝贝。我这老胳膊老腿的，怕是...

say:10:1028324008:1.text: Leave the honey to us, and we'll return so you can make the smelling salts!
say:10:1028324008:1.source_cn: 跑腿的事情交给我们，一会儿制作嗅盐就麻烦您了！

say:1:1028325002:0.text: Be wary of that hornleaf bear; it looks on edge.
say:1:1028325002:0.source_cn: 小心那只叶角熊，它看起来很凶猛。
say:1:1028325002:0.male: Be wary of that hornleaf bear; it looks on edge.
say:1:1028325002:0.female: Be wary of that hornleaf bear; it looks on edge.

say:2:1028325003:0.text: Let's try to sneak closer, preferably without alerting it.
say:2:1028325003:0.source_cn: 试试看能不能偷偷溜进去，最好别惊动叶角熊……

say:0:1028326001:0.text: We've got the golden honey; now let's get back to Ivoryshade!
say:0:1028326001:0.source_cn: 拿到“黄金蜂蜜”了，我们快些回月影乡吧！

say:1:1028327001:1.text: I have prepared all the other ingredients and can begin to make the smelling salts. Patience now, this cannot be rushed.
say:1:1028327001:1.source_cn: 其他的材料我都备好了，这就开始制作嗅盐。别急，年轻人，...

say:2:1028327002:1.text: Sir... my companion who mistakenly drank the elixir... will it have any lasting impact on him?
say:2:1028327002:1.source_cn: 老人家……我的同伴误喝了这药，不会对身体有什么影响吧？

say:3:1028327003:1.text: Oh no, nothing that hasn't already been done. Haha, it would make a very effective cure for insomnia.
say:3:1028327003:1.source_cn: 别的倒也没有什么，就是会睡得很沉，哈哈……治疗失眠的话...

say:6:1028327005:1.text: But if its only effect is to put people to sleep, why is it written that it's an elixir of "eternal youth?"
say:6:1028327005:1.source_cn: 可如果它的作用只有让人沉眠，为什么古老的石碑上记载着它...

say:7:1028327006:1.text: Hahaha, it's true that it can grant "eternal youth", but it's a bit of an exaggerated claim made by our ancestors.
say:7:1028327006:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈，说它能“永葆青春”倒也没错，但那不过是祖先们夸...

choice_prompt:8:1028327006.text: Hahaha, it's true that it can grant "eternal youth", but it's a bit of an exaggerated claim made by our ancestors.
choice_prompt:8:1028327006.source_cn: 哈哈哈，说它能“永葆青春”倒也没错，但那不过是祖先们夸大的说法而已。

say:9:1028327007:1.text: The elixir does indeed slow the aging process, but only while the consumer lies in the sleep it induces.
say:9:1028327007:1.source_cn: 这种灵药会让人沉睡，衰老速度也跟着变慢，自然永葆青春。

say:12:1028327009:1.text: But this elixir is too potent. Without these smelling salts, an everlasting slumber is probable. At times, it's even been used as poison of sorts.
say:12:1028327009:1.source_cn: 但这药太猛烈，如果没有这种嗅盐，甚至真的会让人长眠不醒...

say:14:1028327011:1.text: Don't worry; as long as you wake him up in a timely manner, it won't do any harm.
say:14:1028327011:1.source_cn: 放心吧，只要及时唤醒就不会对身体有伤害。

say:16:1028327012:1.text: That said, the formula, in turn, has been improved upon and refined generation after generation.
say:16:1028327012:1.source_cn: 话说回来，这个药方，反倒是一代又一代人不断改良，做了点...

say:17:1028327013:1.text: Anesthetic ointments used to numb pain during the treatment of external wounds are derived from it.
say:17:1028327013:1.source_cn: 在治疗外伤时能麻醉伤患的麻醉药剂，就是根据这个药方拓展...

say:18:1028327014:1.text: Speaking of which, have you heard of calmflower tea? It can soothe the mind, and its formula is also derived from this recipe.
say:18:1028327014:1.source_cn: 还有的话……“安神花茶”，你们知道吧？能放松心神，也是...

say:19:1028327015:1.text: That's Parisa's favorite kind of tea! I told you the aroma was familiar.
say:19:1028327015:1.source_cn: 原来就是帕瑞莎最爱喝的那种茶！我就说觉得那股味道有点熟悉呢。

say:20:1028327016:1.text: Here, the smelling salts are done—take them! And next time, don't let anyone consume exotic elixirs at random.
say:20:1028327016:1.source_cn: 喏，嗅盐做好了，拿去吧！下次可不能再乱喝东西了啊！

say:21:1028327017:1.text: Got it... Thank you, kind sir!

say:0:1028328001:0.text: Come on, let's hurry back and wake Gali!
say:0:1028328001:0.source_cn: 快走吧，我们赶紧回去叫醒伽利！

say:0:1028329001:0.text: Oh, no! The monsters have Gali surrounded!
say:0:1028329001:0.source_cn: 那是……糟了！怪物把伽利围住了！

say:1:1028329002:0.text: It's our fault for not leaving someone to watch over him. They must see him as an easy snack!
say:1:1028329002:0.source_cn: 都怪我们忘了留个人保护他，他在怪物眼里想必是美味佳肴吧……

say:2:1028330001:1.text: Ah-choo! What's that smell? It's far too pungent!
say:2:1028330001:1.source_cn: 阿——嚏！什么味道……太刺鼻了吧！

say:3:1028330002:1.text: Huh? ...Why are you all looking at me like that?
say:3:1028330002:1.source_cn: 呃……你们怎么这么看着我？

say:4:1028330003:1.source_cn: 伽利！太好了！你终于醒了！

say:5:1028330004:1.text: Didn't I... just drink the elixir? Why... am I a bit dizzy, as if I was just woken up in the middle of the night from a nice, long sleep?
say:5:1028330004:1.source_cn: 我……刚才不是喝了灵药吗？怎么……有点头晕，像是睡到半...

choice_prompt:6:1028330004.text: Didn't I... just drink the elixir? Why... am I a bit dizzy, as if I was just woken up in the middle of the night from a nice, long sleep?
choice_prompt:6:1028330004.source_cn: 我……刚才不是喝了灵药吗？怎么……有点头晕，像是睡到半夜被突然叫醒一样……

say:7:1028330005:1.text: But didn't I just drink an elixir of "eternal youth?" What gives?!
say:7:1028330005:1.source_cn: 但我喝的不是永葆青春的灵药吗？到底是怎么回事？

say:10:1028330009:1.text: What? You mean in order for it to keep you young, it also has to keep you asleep?
say:10:1028330009:1.source_cn: 什么？你是说，它用沉睡不醒的方式来让人“永葆青春”？

say:11:1028330010:1.text:
Ha, "eternal youth!"
Devoid of ambitions and pursuits, all while sleeping motionless... what kind of youth is that??
say:11:1028330010:1.source_cn: 哈，青春！\n——没有激情、没有追求，一动不动睡在那里...

say:12:1028330011:1.text: I would rather apply all my passion to archaeology, searching for eternal truths with a mortal life, than sleep for eternity!
say:12:1028330011:1.source_cn: 比起沉睡的永恒，我宁愿为考古事业付出全部的激情——在有...

say:13:1028330012:1.text: That's real "eternal youth"! At least for scholars, that is...
say:13:1028330012:1.source_cn: 这才是真正的永葆青春！至少，对学者来说是这样的……

say:14:1028330013:1.text: Well said! Gali, I can't help but applaud you. We disagree from time to time, but in this, we're on the same page.
say:14:1028330013:1.source_cn: 说得好！伽利，我都忍不住想给你鼓掌了。咱们时常有分歧，...

say:15:1028330014:1.text: However, you've just lost out on a "major discovery" from an ancient civilization.
say:15:1028330014:1.source_cn: 不过这下，你就会少一个“上古文明的重大发现”了。

say:16:1028330015:1.text: As long as we maintain a passion for archaeology and the thrill of the chase, we will surely make the next "major discovery"!
say:16:1028330015:1.source_cn: 只要有对考古事业的激情和追求，我们一定会有下一个“重大...

choice_prompt:17:1028330015.text: As long as we maintain a passion for archaeology and the thrill of the chase, we will surely make the next "major discovery"!
choice_prompt:17:1028330015.source_cn: 只要有对考古事业的激情和追求，我们一定会有下一个“重大发现”的！

say:18:1028330016:1.text: Of course, our hunt for knowledge never ends!
say:18:1028330016:1.source_cn: 当然，我们永远不会停下探求知识的步伐！

say:19:1028330017:1.text: Perhaps when we next meet, we'll have something even more extraordinary to dazzle the academic community with.
say:19:1028330017:1.source_cn: 也许下次见面时，我们就会有能被学界铭记的重大成果了！

say:20:1028330018:1.text: Farewell, everyone, and thank you for your help!
say:20:1028330018:1.source_cn: 再会啦，各位，谢谢你们的帮助！

say:22:1028330007:1.text: What? Isn't this the elixir of "eternal youth?" I assure you my translation of the tablet was correct!
say:22:1028330007:1.source_cn: 什么？这难道不是永葆青春的灵药吗？我保证我对石碑的翻译...

say:23:1028330008:0.text: Your translation was indeed correct, however...
say:23:1028330008:0.source_cn: 你的翻译的确没错，但这药……

narration:0:1028332001:1.text: The scent of salt did its trick, and Gali gradually opened his eyes.

say:0:1028334001:0.text: Finally, the threat is gone. Let's go grab that golden honey!
say:0:1028334001:0.source_cn: 总算没有威胁了，去拿“黄金蜂蜜”吧！
